product_desc: The Dell Inspiron 7472 is a 14-inch consumer-oriented laptop, part of the Inspiron 7000 series. It features an 8th generation Intel Core processor and options for discrete graphics.

product_features.Processor: 8th Generation Intel Core i5-8250U or Intel Core i7-8550U
product_features.Memory: Up to 16 GB DDR4 2400 MHz (typically 4GB or 8GB configurations available, with one memory slot)
product_features.Storage: Configurable with various options including 2.5-inch hard drives and/or M.2 PCIe solid-state drives. Common configurations include 1TB HDD, 256GB SSD, 128GB SSD + 500GB HDD, or 1.1TB hybrid drives.
product_features.Display Resolution: Full HD (1920 x 1080) IPS Truelife LED-Backlit Display
product_features.Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 (integrated) and optional NVIDIA GeForce MX150 with 2GB GDDR5 graphics memory (discrete)
product_features.Battery Life: 3-cell “smart” lithium-ion (42 WHr), with decent battery life.
product_features.Ports: 1 x USB 2.0, 2 x USB 3.1 Gen 1 (one charging), 1 x HDMI 1.4a, 1 x Headphone/microphone combo jack, SD card reader. No USB-C port.
product_features.Accessories Included: May include a Dell Essential Briefcase with certain purchases.
product_features.Durability: Metal clad premium design, but some reviews note potential quality issues around plastic joints.
product_features.Special Features: Integrated Widescreen HD 720P Webcam with Dual Digital Microphone Array, 2x2W speakers, slim display bezels.
